name: clawd-tracker
description: A Domino's-style order tracker above the prompt. Clawd acts out every step next to an honest progress bar, a learned ETA, a delivery receipt, plan usage and a delivery ding. Themes: pizza, coffee, rocket, construction.

showCost.title: Show cost estimate
showCost.description: Show the ≈$ figure (API list prices; on Pro/Max you are not billed per token).

showPlanUsage.title: Show plan usage
showPlanUsage.description: Show your 5-hour and weekly limit usage, and warn once at 90%.

sound.title: Delivery ding
sound.description: Play a short chime when a job that took 20 seconds or more is delivered.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Stage names: pizza (Reading → Delivered), coffee (Grinding → Served), rocket (Fueling → In orbit) or construction (Surveying → Handed over).
